posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked: I used kali linux dual boot with windows, but now my linux has some other issues and I am not able to acces it. So I installed WSL in my windows 11 partition and tried but am getting this, pls help. @pds_staff

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Simply regenerate ssh key and upload it to the website

posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked: this screenshot was taken after doing that

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Have you generated the new ssh key from wsl ,
Copied it
Pasted it in the se2001 website and submitted?

posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked: @sayan i did it from wsl inc the keygen

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: When generating the new key, did you give it a custom name or path?

posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked: @sayan tried custom name first then second time default…both turned out lyk this

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: In WSL, are you using ssh-keygen or ssh-keygen.exe to generate the key?

posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked:
@sayan im trying with .exe but key im getting as id_ed25519 instead of id_rsa , is that correct? is that ok?
looks like i need to change permissions as well
700 600

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If you are using WSL better to do without using .exe. Any kind of key is fine, both ed25519 and rsa are valid.

Permissions should be automatically set.

posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked: I got it by finding the directory where ssh key was generated, in my case it was generated in a different location , I had to manually search and then change the permissions 700 and 600, its gets faster if done by terminal itself.
